card.name: Drug names in interaction passages
card.fires_on: Responds to the end or middle of a drug name (digoxin, oxycodone, warfarin, lithium) or a linking word like 'combination' in drug-interaction text. Also fires on a few acronyms or disease names in general web text.

modes.label: Digoxin and similar names
modes.description: Final or middle piece of a drug name such as digoxin, warfarin or oxycodone in interaction sections.
modes.example: Digox<<in>> Digoxin is a narrow therapeutic index

modes.label: Interacting drug named
modes.description: The second drug or linking word in a statement about two drugs used together.
modes.example: Do not use fluoxetine in<< combination>> with thioridazine or pim

modes.label: Other acronyms and terms
modes.description: Acronym ends or disease names in general web text.
modes.example: have higher rates of<< HIV>> infection than men

card.writes: No clear link to the tokens promoted or suppressed, which are mixed and mostly unrelated words.
card.plain: It lights up on drug names, especially digoxin, inside passages about drugs affecting each other.
